health.title: Life-stage nutrition

kitchen.safetyNote: This supports home handling; it does not replace recall notices, product labels, or local public-health advice.

receive.bestBeforeHint: Leave blank when there is no label date; the system will not guess.
receive.errorSave: Could not save yet. Your input is kept so you can retry.
receive.errorLotExists: This lot is already in the pantry and cannot be silently removed.
inventory.signal.later: Time remains according to the label
inventory.errorStock: The recorded quantity exceeds the current balance.
inventory.errorSave: Could not save yet. Your input is kept so you can retry.
inventory.emptyRecent: No usage or discard activity yet.
inventory.thawBody: Tomorrow’s meals use {items}. Check the label and verified guidance before thawing; the system does not invent a number of hours.
inventory.labelDisclaimer: The label date helps prioritize use; it does not claim the food is safe or spoiled.
cooking.noGuideBody: The housekeeper does not yet have reliable dish-specific steps, so it will not fabricate a generic recipe. Ingredients and nutrition remain available.
cooking.cleanSeparate: Wash hands and surfaces; separate utensils for raw food and cooked food.
coord.title: Coordinate dishes
coord.estimateDisclaimer: Times are estimates for sequencing work. Use each recipe’s safety checks to confirm that food is cooked.
coord.futureTarget: Serving time must be in the future.
coord.unsupportedHint: These dishes do not yet have verified dish-specific workflows.
leftover.captureIntro: Only record food you actually stored. Review and confirm the times below; the app cannot observe your kitchen.
leftover.hotWeatherHint: Only select this when you know the actual conditions; the reviewed cooling window is then 1 hour.
leftover.coolingGuidance: USDA guidance says to refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours, or 1 hour when the ambient temperature is above 32°C/90°F. Use shallow containers for rapid cooling.
leftover.errorCooling: The time from cooking to cold storage exceeds the reviewed guidance. This dish cannot be recorded as actively stored; review the official source and consider discarding it.
leftover.error.CHILLED_BEFORE_PREPARED: Cold-storage time cannot be before cooking was completed.
leftover.error.TIMESTAMP_IN_FUTURE: Times cannot be in the future.
leftover.errorSave: Could not save yet. Your input is kept so you can retry.
leftover.listHint: Cooked dishes, kept separate from ingredient inventory
leftover.empty: No leftovers have been confirmed by the household.
leftover.errorBalance: The amount exceeds the servings remaining.
leftover.reheatBody: Reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F throughout, measured with a food thermometer. Bring sauces, soups, and gravies to a rolling boil.
leftover.disclaimer: Timing helps you review food against guidance; it does not guarantee that food remains safe. If in doubt or the food seems abnormal, do not taste it to test.
agenda.title: Kitchen tasks today
agenda.empty: There are no kitchen tasks with enough recorded evidence.
agenda.emptyBody: The housekeeper only derives reminders from meal plans, purchases, stored lots, and leftovers confirmed by the household.
agenda.sheetIntro: This list is derived from the meal plan, shopping, inventory, and leftovers. Complete work in its source flow; the agenda never marks it done automatically.
agenda.noDone: There is no completion button here. Tasks only change when you confirm data in shopping, inventory, leftovers, or a cooking run.
agenda.unsupported.cookingGuide: {name} has no reviewed dish-specific guide, so no cooking task was created.

agenda.task.reviewLeftover.review: This dish is in days 3–4 of the guidance window and needs household review.
